links.outcome: Whether AI control protocols mitigate medication-harm outputs and resist subversion
links.effect: Existing control protocols can be subverted under a severity-based safety definition; severity-based monitoring is proposed to address this. No numbers in abstract.
links.quote: Under this revised definition, we show that existing control protocols can be subverted and propose severity-based monitoring to address this limitation.
